author: reek
body: Smoke test for STM32L4 board drivers. MMIO stubs return 0. Exercises GPIO, UART, SPI, I2C, RCC clock config, PWR mode registers, and LPTIM configuration.

author: reek
body: The driver functions declare [Device.Mmio], so this test declares it too. A test chapter is not on the effect-exemption list, which means the row the drivers carry is checked right here, at the first caller outside the quire. The sleep-mode names and the delay reach no register, so they stay bound with plain lets.

author: reek
body: The mode names are a pure table, so the four name checks are plain lets computed before the act block. Only the prepare and restore sequences reach the bus.
